description: Comment “Trade” and I’ll send you the full setup guide 👇 You can now connect Claude directly to Robinhood and it can actually manage your portfolio and make trades for you. Robinhood just launched something called Agentic Trading, giving Claude access to its own dedicated investing account that it can trade inside of. Here’s how to set it up: Google “Robinhood MCP,” click the first link, and copy the link at the bottom Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Add → Add Custom Connector Paste it in and sign into your Robinhood account Now Claude can see your entire portfolio, buying power, positions—everything. You can talk to it just like your own personal trading bot. I said: “Analyze my portfolio and tell me where I’m overexposed.” Claude gave me a full breakdown. Then: “I want you to rebalance me so I’m not sitting at 80% in one stock.” Once you give it the green light, Claude can actually go and place real trades for you. Here’s the part that makes this reasonable: it can only trade inside its own separate account, not your main one, and you have to approve everything before it happens. #ai #claude #robinhood #investing #aitools
